name: Tater Tot "Tachos" with Queso, Crispy Bacon, Avocado, Green Onions & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 475°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Transfer tater tots to the baking sheet. Sprinkle with taco seasoning, toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (907 g) bag tater tots or puffs, frozen
1 ½ tbsp taco seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Once heated, place tater tots in the oven and bake, tossing once, until golden brown and crispy, about 20 minutes (or cook according to package instructions).
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Wipe the pot clean with paper towels and reserve for the next step.)

Using a clean cutting board, medium dice cheese, then place in the reserved pot along with ro-tel tomatoes & chilies. Set the pot over low heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted and smooth, about 5 minutes. Remove cheese sauce from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and cut into bite-sized pieces. Place on a plate.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the plate with the avocado.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the plate.
When the tater tots are done, remove from the oven and transfer to a serving platter. Top with cheese sauce, bacon, avocado, green onions, and cilantro. Enjoy!
